text:
Priya S: Quick sync  I'm assembling a small docs PR that bundles: (1) a Go SDK snippet for patching scalePolicy, (2) a short rollback example for provisioning mistakes, (3) wording for SLA impacts when doing live rollouts with tenant_isolation. want to keep it micro.

Marco L: love the bundle. Support asked for a concrete rollback one-liner they can run during incidents. also include a short note that rollback does NOT rewind capacity billing.

Yasmin Q: runtime confirm: graceful_scale behaves same across languages; it delays eviction but cooldown continues. i'll add an eng-runtime-approved sentence.

Priya S: drafting content. Go SDK snippet (1-liner style):
```go
// assume client is *redwood.Client
err := client.PatchPool(ctx, poolID, redwood.PatchPoolOptions{
    ScalePolicy: &redwood.ScalePolicy{Cooldown: 300, GracefulScale: ptr.Bool(true)},
})
```

Marco L: perfect. can we also add a tiny YAML rollback example that support can paste?

Priya S: rollback CLI (safe revert to last-known good): `rwctl pool rollback --id $POOL --to last-good` and an explicit patch rollback: `rwctl pool patch --id $POOL --set scalePolicy.cooldown=600` as an emergency mitigation.

Yasmin Q: adding runtime-approved sentence for the doc: "Note: enabling graceful_scale reduces eviction of warm replicas to preserve KV caches, but autoscale cooldown and Dedicated capacity accounting continue to elapse during drains." use exact phrasing please.

Marco L: also include a small entry in the SLA section: "Time spent in deployment/drain counts toward capacity commitments; rolling back doesn't credit previously consumed time." support should not overpromise.

Priya S: good call. will cross-link to /docs/dedicated/sla/commitments.md and add a one-line banner in the rollout guide.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5482 branch: docs/provisioning/rollout-go-rollback. CI: lint ok, link-checker flagged docs/dedicated/sla.md as a stale relative link.

Marco L: small UX ask: add a short example showing A/B rollout toggle for scalePolicy so platforms teams can do canary config changes. a 3-line YAML showing variant A/B would be ideal.

Priya S: adding a tiny canary snippet:
```yaml
# canary toggle
pool:
  id: example-pool
  rollout:
    config:
      default: stable
      variants:
        stable:
          scalePolicy: { cooldown: 300 }
        canary:
          scalePolicy: { cooldown: 120 }
```

Yasmin Q: runtime note: caution callout: canary with shorter cooldown + tenant_isolation may oscillate; recommend increasing canary cooldown or limiting canary to 5% of traffic.

Marco L: yes add a short recommended practice line: "Limit canary to <=5% traffic and monitor placement latency; increase cooldown if oscillation observed."

Priya S: added that. also adding a tiny localization note: docs examples should avoid region-specific labels in YAML (use placeholders) because translations copy snippets directly. changed labels to placeholders like $REGION.

docs-bot: CI: link-checker suggests replacing docs/dedicated/sla.md -> /docs/dedicated/sla/commitments.md. PR updated.

eng-runtime-bot: runtime verifies wording. graceful_scale text approved. left internal ticket ref: INT-2026 for future cooldown-pausing feature.

Marco L: action items: (1) Priya: push Go snippet + rollback + canary + SLA cross-ref, (2) Yasmin: confirm runtime sentence in review, (3) Marco: prepare support KB entry linking to the new doc. aim to merge today.

Priya S: pushed updates. merging after CI. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR merged (5482) by Priya S  changes deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/rollout-examples-go-rollback.html

Yasmin Q: checked staging, all snippets render fine. leaving a very small grammar nit.

Marco L: I'll draft the support KB and paste link once prod live. closing thread.
